  - region "Simple English explanation of Coordinate Transformations":
    - paragraph: In simple English
    - heading "Understand Coordinate Transformations" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "A coordinate transformation maps (x,y) to a new pair. (x,y)↦(x+2,y−1) sends (1,3) to (3,2). Linear maps can also rotate or scale the axes. A useful rule is Translation rule: (x,y)->(x+a,y+b). You can learn Coordinate Transformations by trying one small example instead of long theory."
    - paragraph: "Apply the stated rule to both coordinates of each given point and plot the image. Example: Translate (3,4) by (2,-1). Add 2 to x. Add -1 to y. So the answer is (5,3)."
    - paragraph: "In real life, graphics: Move shapes on a screen. Watch out: Transforming one vertex but not the whole shape. Apply the rule to every point."
    - complementary:
      - generic: Try this example
      - paragraph: Translate (3,4) by (2,-1).
      - generic "Compare your answer"
